title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1971-07-02

ai_review.summary: High‑quality FM soundboard capture of the historic 1971 Fillmore closing, highlighted by Pigpen’s fire and strong performances of The Rub, Hard to Handle, Deal and Mama Tried.
ai_review.review: The recording is sourced from the live‑to‑air FM broadcast and is praised for its crispness, depth and reduced clicks (especially in the clevenger_lai_fix‑128 version). Musically the show is a long, loose‑but‑cohesive set with Pigpen taking center stage; standout moments include The Rub, Hard to Handle, Deal, Mama Tried and Big Boss Man, while the first set is viewed as weaker than the second. Overall listeners find it an enjoyable snapshot of the band’s 1971 “Skull Fuck” era despite some minor sonic imperfections.

ai_rating.rationale: Three out of four reviewers gave 4‑5 stars and praised both the performance (especially Pigpen) and the FM soundboard quality; one mixed review lowers the average slightly, yielding a solid 4.2 rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: FM broadcast feed from the board; generally crisp with good spectrum and depth. The clevenger_lai_fix‑128 version has fewer clicks and better overall clarity, though some earlier pre‑FM mixes exhibit more noise.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A lengthy two‑set show; the first set is considered weaker (B‑ rating) while the second set improves (C+), with Pigpen’s energy lifting the overall momentum.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Great Strat guitar tone noted; playing before his later “Alligator” mods.
